model_annotation: The image displays three side-by-side pie charts representing different logical or linguistic classifications, respectively titled "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive &Conjunctive." There is no external legend; instead, all category labels and their corresponding percentages are displayed directly inside the slices using bold text, and none of the segments are visually emphasized by being exploded or offset. The first chart, "Categorical," consists of four slices: a light blue-grey slice for "Universal Quantifiers" (29.07%), a light pink slice for "Limiter" (27.91%), a light orange slice for "Negation" (27.91%), and a light green slice for "Existential Quantifiers" (15.12%). The second chart, "Approximate Number Generation," contains three slices arranged clockwise in descending order of size: a light beige slice for "Approximate Quantities" (45.03%), a light blue slice for "Comparative Relationships" (36.26%), and a light purple slice for "Absolute Absence" (18.71%). The third chart, "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal slices: a light pinkish-purple segment for "Conjunctive" (50.49%) and a light blue-grey segment for "Disjunctive" (49.51%).
